title: Investigating the adsorption of organic compounds onto microplastics via experimental, simulation, and prediction methods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,849-859
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00586D, Critical Review
Ya Wang, Peng Zhao, Honghong Yi, Xiaolong Tang
This review summarizes the research progress on the adsorption of organic pollutants onto microplastics with different techniques, i.e., experiments, simulations, and prediction models, and provides perspectives for future research.
